# Project Details

The `details.go` file contains all project metadata constants and the version variable. This file is code-generated from the parent project configuration to maintain consistency across the Nevaria ecosystem.

## Constants

### Name

```go
const Name = "Nevaria"
```

The human-readable name of the project. Used for display purposes, CLI output, and user-facing text.

**Usage:**
```go
fmt.Printf("Welcome to %s\n", project.Name)
// Output: Welcome to Nevaria
```

### Slug

```go
const Slug = "nevaria"
```

URL-friendly version of the project name. Used in URLs, identifiers, and places where a lowercase, hyphen-free identifier is needed.

**Usage:**
```go
userAgent := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", project.Slug, project.Version)
// Example: "nevaria/1.0.0"
```

### Description

```go
const Description = "AI Agent Gateway"
```

Short description of the project's purpose. Used for help text, documentation headers, and metadata.

**Usage:**

```go
fmt.Printf("%s - %s\n", project.Name, project.Description)
// Output: Nevaria - AI Agent Gateway
```

### ModulePath

```go
const ModulePath = "github.com/nevaria-ai/gateway"
```

The Go module import path for this repository. Used for code generation, import statements, and dependency management.

**Usage:**

```go
// When generating code that imports this package
importPath := fmt.Sprintf("%s/internal/agent", project.ModulePath)
// Result: "github.com/nevaria-ai/gateway/internal/agent"
```

### BinaryName

```go
const BinaryName = "nevaria-gateway"
```

The output binary name when the project is compiled. Used for build scripts, installation, and CLI references.

**Usage:**
```go
binaryPath := filepath.Join(binDir, project.BinaryName)
// Result: "/usr/local/bin/nevaria-gateway"
```

## Variables

### Version

```go
var Version = "dev"
```

The current version of the software. This variable is designed to be overridden at build time using ldflags.

**Default Value:** `"dev"` (used when no build-time version is provided)

**Build-Time Override:**
```bash
# Set version during build
go build -ldflags="-X 'github.com/nevaria-ai/gateway/internal/project.Version=v1.0.0'"
```

**Usage Examples:**

```go
// Display version
func printVersion() {
    fmt.Printf("%s version %s\n", project.Name, project.Version)
}

// Version command
if *versionFlag {
    fmt.Println(project.Version)
    os.Exit(0)
}

// HTTP response header
w.Header().Set("X-Server-Version", project.Version)
```

## Complete Usage Example

```go
package main

import (
    "flag"
    "fmt"
    "os"

    "github.com/nevaria-ai/gateway/internal/project"
)

var versionFlag = flag.Bool("version", false, "Print version and exit")

func main() {
    flag.Parse()

    if *versionFlag {
        fmt.Printf("%s v%s\n", project.Name, project.Version)
        fmt.Printf("%s\n", project.Description)
        os.Exit(0)
    }

    // Normal startup
    fmt.Printf("Starting %s (%s)\n", project.Name, project.BinaryName)
    fmt.Printf("Module: %s\n", project.ModulePath)
}
```

## Build Integration

### Makefile Example

```makefile
VERSION ?= dev
LDFLAGS := -ldflags="-X 'github.com/nevaria-ai/gateway/internal/project.Version=$(VERSION)'"

build:
    go build $(LDFLAGS) -o bin/$(BINARY_NAME) ./cmd/gateway

.PHONY: build
```

### Git Tag Integration

```makefile
VERSION := $(shell git describe --tags --always --dirty)
LDFLAGS := -ldflags="-X 'github.com/nevaria-ai/gateway/internal/project.Version=$(VERSION)'"
```
